Workflow.Name: Change Radar handler: Digest-Weekly
Workflow.Description: Change Radar handler Digest-Weekly: every Monday, one card summarising the week's queued digest runs (new and changed signals, exposures, ratings) to each chat: and channel: entry in alert_destinations (and alert_recipient). Posts only (writes = no; ADR 0011 and its addendum).
